discription: A pulse wave synth with pulse width modulation (PWM) controlled by an LFO. This adds a dynamic, evolving timbre to a classic pulse sound.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, pulseWidth=0.5, pwmRate=2, pwmDepth=0.1;var sig;var env = EnvGen.ar(Env.adsr(0.01, 0.1, 0.8, 1.0, curve: -4),gate: gate,doneAction: 2);var mod = SinOsc.kr(pwmRate) * pwmDepth + pulseWidth;mod = mod.clip(0.01, 0.99);sig = Pulse.ar(freq, mod) * amp * env;Out.ar(out, sig ! 2);}
